article.story: HUNTSVILLE, Ala. -- — Cotie McMahon scored 20 points and Christeen Iwuala added 15 for No. 12 Mississippi in an 84-45 win over Alabama A&M on Friday night. Ole Miss (2-0) took a 5-4 lead with 8:12 to go in the first quarter off a layup from McMahon, her 1,500th career point, and the Rebels led the rest of the way. Ole Miss ended the first quarter on a 14-0 run. McMahon shot 7 for 11 from the field and 2 for 5 from 3-point range. Iwuala had seven rebounds and shot 7 for 10. Moses Davenport led the Lady Bulldogs (1-1) with 18 points and 10 rebounds. Alabama A&M committed 31 turnovers for 36 Mississippi points. Ole Miss shot 45.2% from the field and 21 for 30 from the free throw line. ------ Get poll alerts and updates on the AP Top 25 throughout the season. Sign up here.
